title: Fraudulent merchant onboarded via KYC screening gap
root_cause_detail: A merchant was onboarded without the enhanced-due-diligence step that the KYC runbook requires for its risk tier; the account was then used to process fraudulent transactions before it was caught.

contributing_factors.factor: Elevated cross-border transaction volume that week increased overall queue load.
A monitoring dashboard was briefly degraded during the window.

regulatory.note: Customer-impacting incidents above either threshold trigger a mandatory regulator/customer notification per the disclosure policy.
